_: Terms that must survive translation unchanged. 'brands' is ACTIVE. 'aeGlossary' is INACTIVE by design - the user chose 'protect only brand names' on 2026-07-30. Set aeGlossaryEnabled to true to also freeze After Effects terminology; see notes below for why you might want to.
_whyAeGlossaryMatters: Measured against the live Google endpoint on 2026-07-30: 'Ease' -> 'Facilidad' (Spanish for 'easiness/facility', not the AE easing term) and 'Wiggle' -> 'Menear' ('to wag'). Neither matches any label in a Spanish After Effects install, so a translated tooltip can send a user hunting for a control that is not named that. Flipping aeGlossaryEnabled to true and re-running the fill pins these to English. No code change needed - the engine reads this flag at boot.
